Terms of Service

Whispering Woods Luxe · Harvard, Illinois · Effective September 5, 2026 · Privacy Policy

⚠️ Non-Refundable Deposit: By completing payment, you agree that your $710 (50%) deposit is strictly non-refundable and your session proceeds rain or shine. No exceptions.

1. Non-Refundable Deposit & Balance Terms

  • A 50% non-refundable deposit of $710 is required to secure your spot.
  • This deposit reserves a dedicated HMU chair, photographer, and time slot for your senior.
  • All deposits are strictly non-refundable. No exceptions.
  • The remaining balance of $710 is due 10 days prior to the event date.
  • Failure to pay the remaining balance by the due date will result in automatic forfeiture of your reserved spot to the waitlist, with no refund of the deposit.
  • If you fail to show up at the designated location and time, you forfeit the session fee and a new session fee will be required to book a future session.

2. Weather & Rescheduling Policy

  • We shoot rain or shine. We have indoor barn + projector room backups that create stunning moody editorial shots.
  • Weather conditions do not constitute grounds for a refund or rescheduling. Our indoor backup locations ensure a premium experience regardless of weather.
  • In the event of extreme weather, acts of God, fire, strike, or other circumstances beyond our control, we will make every reasonable effort to accommodate your session. However, no refunds will be given.

3. Model Release & Image Usage

  • By booking a session, you grant Whispering Woods Luxe and its photographers the right to use selected images for portfolio, website, social media, advertising, and marketing purposes.
  • You acknowledge that no compensation will be provided for the use of these images.
  • If you do not wish your images to be used in this way, please inform us in writing before the session date.
  • If the senior is under 18, the parent or legal guardian must sign this agreement on their behalf.

4. Copyright & Image Ownership

  • All images remain the sole property of Whispering Woods Luxe and the photographer. Copyright is not transferred to the client.
  • Clients receive a personal use license to download, share, and print the images for personal use only.
  • Images may not be sold, edited beyond minor adjustments, or used for commercial purposes without written permission.
  • Images may not be cropped beyond minor adjustments or altered without written permission.

5. Liability & Indemnification

  • Whispering Woods Luxe is not liable for events outside our control, including but not limited to weather, illness, equipment failure, or lost files.
  • In the event of non-performance, liability is limited to a full refund of all payments received.
  • Clients are responsible for their own safety and the safety of their belongings while on the property.
  • Clients agree to follow all property rules and instructions from staff. Whispering Woods Luxe is not liable for injuries or damages caused by failure to follow instructions.
  • Client agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Whispering Woods Luxe from any claims, damages, or liabilities arising from client's conduct during the session.

6. Rescheduling & Cancellation

  • Deposits are non-refundable. We reserve a dedicated HMU chair, photographer, and time slot just for you.
  • If you cannot attend, you may transfer your spot to another senior. All transfers must be coordinated with us in writing.
  • If you choose not to attend and do not transfer your spot, your spot will be released to the waitlist. No refund will be issued.
  • Rescheduling is only permitted in the event of a documented medical emergency and is subject to availability. A new $710 deposit may be required.

7. Privacy

Our collection and use of personal data is described in our Privacy Policy. By booking, you consent to the practices described therein.

8. Booking & Payment Processing

  • All payments are processed securely through Stripe.
  • We do not store your credit card information. Stripe handles all payment processing.
  • A receipt will be emailed to you upon successful payment.

9. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution

  • This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois.
  • Any disputes arising from this agreement shall be resolved through binding arbitration in McHenry County, Illinois.
  • If any provision of this agreement is found to be unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.

10. Client Acknowledgments

  • By booking and paying the deposit, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to all terms and conditions outlined above.
  • You confirm that the senior is at least 16 years old, or that you are the parent/legal guardian and are signing on their behalf.
  • You consent to receive email communications regarding your booking, including confirmation, reminders, and balance due notifications.
